ChatGPT users can now book restaurants and join waitlists directly within the conversation through Yelp. Here are the details.

Yelp expands ChatGPT integration

A few weeks ago, Yelp and ChatGPT reached a content partnership agreement, bringing Yelp's reviews, ratings, photos and other business information directly into ChatGPT's responses.

Yelp announced today that it is expanding this integration, with users in the United States and Canada now able to make reservations or join waitlists through Yelp directly within the chat interface.

Yelp stated:

Combining both features, this expanded collaboration now allows users to ask for restaurant recommendations seamlessly within a single conversation, and if there are available seats, they can directly book a table or join the waitlist, including party size, date and time, contact information, special requests and confirmation — completing the entire reservation process.

Yelp pointed out that this integration further expands the platform's presence in AI search, including natural citations. Yelp mentioned in the press release: "Yelp is the most-cited home services discovery platform, leading its closest competitor by 3.4 times in citation volume across major AI platforms."

To learn more about the new integration between Yelp and ChatGPT, you can visit this link.
